name: exilequesting
description: A modern, build-aware Path of Exile campaign companion for Windows.
author: Stoffe101

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:manifest && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.visual:overlay: npm run build && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1 . --visual-smoke=artifacts/visual/100 && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1.25 . --visual-smoke=artifacts/visual/125 && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1.5 . --visual-smoke=artifacts/visual/150
scripts.visual:manager: npm run build && esbuild tools/visual-manager.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=.tmp/visual-manager.cjs && electron .tmp/visual-manager.cjs artifacts/manager-visual
scripts.visual:gear: npm run build && esbuild tools/visual-gear-coach.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=.tmp/visual-gear-coach.cjs && electron .tmp/visual-gear-coach.cjs artifacts/manager-visual/gear-coach
scripts.visual:passive-hud: npm run build && esbuild tools/visual-passive-tree-hud.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=.tmp/visual-passive-tree-hud.cjs && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1 .tmp/visual-passive-tree-hud.cjs artifacts/passive-tree-hud/100 && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1.25 .tmp/visual-passive-tree-hud.cjs artifacts/passive-tree-hud/125 && electron --force-device-scale-factor=1.5 .tmp/visual-passive-tree-hud.cjs artifacts/passive-tree-hud/150
scripts.smoke:lab: npm run build && esbuild tools/smoke-lab.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=.tmp/smoke-lab.cjs && electron .tmp/smoke-lab.cjs
scripts.verify:preplaytest: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:gems && npm run validate:passives && npm run validate:manifest && npm run audit:campaign && npm run lint:campaign && npm run simulate:campaign
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
